Which AR Glasses Suit Daily Use?

February 11, 2026

AR glasses in 2026 split into audio-first fashion (Meta Ray‑Ban), full AR displays (RayNeo X3 Pro), and camera/fitness‑focused wearables — pick by whether you want discreet AI help, visual overlays, or workout-ready capture.

Solos AirGo V2 targets active users with a lightweight build, 16MP camera, ChatGPT-backed SolosChat, fitness coaching, long battery life, and accessible $299 pricing.
